body: Read-only live-diff check: the quotient-level clamp and tiny-denominator rejection look right. One exact gate detail before recut: chief required 1 + 1e-9 to clamp and 1 + 2e-9 to be Left. Current test uses 1.0000000005 for the clamp, so it does not pin the inclusive maximum tolerance boundary. Please use 1.0 + 1e-9 (or add it) alongside 1.0 + 2e-9.
